text_to_image_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original landscape scene asset, 1536x1024, full-bleed independent image for an interactive story environment library. Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Photoreal cinematic polar research observatory, low curved glass dome on a glacier, aurora sweeping over icy mountains, warmly illuminated interior visible through curved glass, cobalt snow and emerald sky, finely resolved frost, gentle film halation, wide environment with empty foreground.
